title: Clarivate Commences Offer to Purchase for Cash Certain of its Outstanding Debt Securities
summary: Clarivate Plc (NYSE: CLVT) ("Clarivate"), a leading global provider of transformative intelligence, today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Clarivate Science Holdings Corporation (the "Company"), has commenced a cash tender offer (the "Offer") to purchase the outstanding notes described below, upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Offer to Purchase dated September 17, 2026 (the "Offer to Purchase").
